title: Place an order from cart checkout
description: A shopper can move from a populated cart to checkout and complete an order, resulting in an order confirmation.

steps.description: Navigate to /menu
Open a menu item detail page
Add the item to the cart
Go to the cart
Proceed to checkout
Complete the order submission
Verify an order confirmation is displayed
Verify the placed order is reflected in the completion state
